newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down one cents to 15.02 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down one cents to 15.02 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell a marginal cent to 15.02 ringgit ($6.01) a kg, leading to a huge premium against the London market, which plunged overnight.

"Some good covering by Europeans and local buyers kept the local price from plunging," said a dealer. "I think this was one week that the local market did not follow London but this could change by next week depending on players' positions."

Turnover fell to 109 tonnes from 100 tonnes on Thursday. Bids totalled 87 tonnes against offers of 124. Dealers said there was a premium of $55 compared to Wednesday's discount of $15. -- Barani Krishnaan (603-230-7509) ($1=2.4990 ringgit)
